content:
There are now less than 24 hours left to take advantage of the 2026 fall Prime Day sale, folks. Alongside big-ticket Apple releases like the all-time lows on the new M6 Mac mini and Apple Watch Series 12, we are also tracking a ton of notable official first-and third-party iPhone, iPad, and Mac accessory deals as well.

If you ask me, the best accessory for all of your Apple gear is AirPods Pro 3 at nearly 30% off, but we also have all-time lows on Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro cases, the very first discount on the brand new 2026 Apple Magic Keyboard, rare deals on Magic Mouse, and AirTag 2 from $22.50 each. All of which join a plethora of discounts on 25W MagSafe chargers and more from top brands like Anker, Belkin, Satechi, and Logitech. Check it all out down below.

AirPods

There’s not very many folks who would call the world’s greatest earbuds an accessory, but they, all things considered, very much are the very best accessory you can buy for any iPhone, iPad, or Mac – they also happen to be sitting at the some of the lowest prices to date, so let’s get those out of the way first:

Logitech’s Mac accessories are also seeing some solid discounts for fall Prime Day, with one of the highlights being its Signature Slim Solar+ K980 wireless keyboard at $72.19 shipped. That’s down to the lowest price we’ve tracked for it. This keyboard can keep itself powered using both sunlight and indoor light, so you never have to worry about plugging it in or swapping batteries.
